faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: What is PLANN and how does it work?
faq.a1: PLANN is an online system that allows businesses to easily manage their appointments. You can effortlessly perform customer, staff and appointment operations from the user panel.
faq.q2: How can I become a member?
faq.a2: To become a member of PLANN, click the Get Started button to easily create your business registration.
faq.q3: Is there a free trial period?
faq.a3: Yes, you can try PLANN free for 7 days. After the trial period, you can continue by selecting the package you want.
faq.q4: What happens if I exceed my appointment limit?
faq.a4: When you exceed the appointment limit specified in your package, you cannot create new appointments. You can continue by upgrading to a higher limit package.
faq.q5: How do billing and payment processes work?
faq.a5: All payments are made online through secure infrastructure and automatic invoices are created every month. You can access invoices from your panel.
faq.q6: Can I use the system on mobile devices?
faq.a6: Yes, PLANN is mobile-friendly. It works seamlessly on both mobile phones and tablets.
faq.a7: Yes, each package allows you to add a certain number of staff accounts. You can upgrade to higher packages to expand.
faq.q8: Are reminder SMS sent to my customers?
faq.a8: Yes, with PLANN, an information SMS is sent when you first create the appointment. Also, a reminder SMS is automatically sent to your customers 2 hours before the appointment.
faq.q9: Can I export my customer information?
faq.a9: Yes, you can export your customer information in Excel format.
faq.a10: Yes, our support team is happy to help you every weekday. You can create a support request from within the panel.
faq.a11: Yes, at PLANN we store all your data encrypted on secure servers. Your data is not shared with third parties.
